title: Payer filing limits, appeal windows and liability notice forms: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Larkfield's billing office works claims for the Urology and Continence Supply Program under the filing limits, appeal windows and advance-notice forms of each payer program. This schedule states them for every tier. All day counts are calendar days.

## Definitions

- **Timely-filing limit**: the payer's limit for an original claim, counted from the date of service, which is the ship date. A figure of 0 means no payer claim is filed on the tier.
- **Corrected-claim window**: the time allowed to submit a corrected claim after an unprocessable (CO-16) denial, counted from the posting date of that denial. A figure of 0 means it does not apply.
- **First-level appeal window**: the time allowed to file the first-level appeal, counted from the posting date of the denial. The first level is a commercial internal appeal, a Medicare Advantage reconsideration, a Medicare redetermination or a Medicaid plan appeal. A figure of 0 means no payer appeal exists.
- **Second-level appeal window**: the time allowed to file the second-level appeal, counted from the posting date of the first-level appeal decision. The second level is a commercial external review, a Medicare QIC reconsideration or a Medicaid state fair hearing. A figure of 0 means the customer files no second level: the self-pay tier has none, and on the Medicare Advantage tier the plan forwards an upheld denial to the independent review entity automatically.
- **Liability notice form**: the advance notice of financial liability that a customer must sign before an item or quantity expected to be denied can be billed to them.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Timely-filing limit (days from ship date) | 0 | 90 | 180 | 180 | 365 | 365 |
| Corrected-claim window (days from denial posting) | 0 | 90 | 180 | 180 | 365 | 365 |
| First-level appeal window (days from denial posting) | 0 | 180 | 180 | 65 | 120 | 60 |
| Second-level appeal window (days from first-level decision posting) | 0 | 120 | 120 | 0 | 180 | 120 |
| Liability notice form | none | plan member waiver | plan member waiver | pre-service organization determination denial (no notice makes the member liable) | Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage (form CMS-R-131) | Medicaid non-covered services agreement |


## Points of reading

- The Continence Self-Pay Program shows 0 in every window. No payer claim is filed on it and no notice form applies.
- On the Continence Medicare Advantage Program the liability entry is not a notice the member signs. It is the plan's pre-service organization determination denial.
- **Example (hypothetical dates).** On a tier with a 90-day timely-filing limit, a refill shipped on the 1st day of a month has a filing limit that ends 90 calendar days after that ship date.
